_comment: High/critical advisories we have knowingly accepted until their major upgrade lands. Anything NOT listed here fails the Security workflow. Remove an entry once it is fixed.

accepted.next: Needs Next.js 16 (major). The image-optimizer RCE is not reachable (images.unoptimized is true); pages are server-rendered, not cached ISR.
accepted.zod: Needs Zod 4 (major). Memory exhaustion on oversized collections; request bodies are already capped at 1 MB.
accepted.expo: Needs an Expo SDK upgrade. Build-time tooling, not shipped in the app.
accepted.@expo/cli: Part of the Expo SDK upgrade. Developer tooling only.
accepted.postcss: Reached through Next/Expo build tooling; only processes our own CSS.
accepted.d3-color: ReDoS in a chart dependency; only parses colours we define.
